reading.read: a frame is read when both slots draw and the cloth slot draws over the leg slot in that frame's draw order; a frame where the leg draws over the cloth is not read
reading.drawn: a point is drawn when the renderer paints it at 128 of 255 or more (half opacity) — the slot's art through its page, tint included
reading.rows: the cloth's rows are cells of one texel of its drawing at its setup pose (the rest table's vertices), on multiples of that texel from the world origin; on each side its corner is the outermost drawn cell in the lower half of its drawn rows, the lowest on a tie, and the rows from the corner up to its top are read
reading.run: on a read row, the number of steps outward from the outermost drawn cell's centre as the frame poses it — in world units, along the setup pose's outward direction carried to the frame by the cloth triangle holding that centre — whose world point the leg draws, up to the first it does not: how far the leg's outline passes the cloth's. A step (cell) is one texel of the coarser of the two drawings at the setup pose, in world units; depth is the run times the step
reading.passes: a frame passes through when some read row's run is 2 steps or more — more than the one step an outline is resolved to
reading.box: a passing frame's box is [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in world units (y up) over both ends of every run of that frame that reaches the line — the cloth's outline and the run's far end
